title: Header
description: header.json — written once per test at the test root (spec §12.2; remediation 3.2). The single home for test metadata: version fields, identities, the test_plan that was run, and the effective logging_config. Parquet rows do NOT repeat this; they carry only join keys. Lets analysis reconstruct exactly what was run without parsing any Parquet.

app_version.description: Per-build semver string of the logger app.

session_id.description: Groups tests recorded in one logging session.

test_start_utc_ns.description: Test start, UTC ns. For human/cross-system reference only.

test_start_mono_ns.description: Test start, mobile monotonic ns. Authoritative origin for relative timing.

host.description: server_host the device connected to for this test.

test_plan.description: The exact plan that was run (embedded verbatim from RUN_TEST).

logging_config.description: The effective config in force for this test (after intersection with capability + overrides).
